_: The legal review of Sophaxis as logic. A law is a disjunction (OR) of conjunctions (AND) of elements. In every conjunction, one element must be denied by a sentence in the policies. A law that sets duties lists, for each duty, the sentences that meet it. verification/check.js confirms that the laws match the headings of docs/legal-review.md, that every sentence exists word for word, and that every pair of actor and act is covered.
